Subject: EOQ micro-credit handshake — Flycap pilot conversion

Team —

Quick one: Flycap is in final internal review and told me they can commit to a 12-month paid contract if we bridge the final usage gap for the rest of their pilot month. They asked for some predictable runway (tokens/credits) plus a one-month trial extension so they can finish a last integration test before cutover.

Requesting approval to offer a one-time $5,000 credit applied to first invoice + a 30-day pilot extension that preserves data isolation. This is strictly conditional on a signed MSA and the HubSpot deal closing by 2026-09-03 (EOQ).

Why this is ok:
- Flycap is projecting $150k ARR in year 1 per our forecast and the buyer (Jordan Lee, CFO) is aligned on procurement timing.
- The credit only applies to usage and expires 60 days after issuance; no product changes.
- We keep a clear canary: credit code bound to deal id FLYC-278 and single-use.

If you’re good, I’ll prepare the DocuSign and the credit token mechanics. I’ve attached the updated mutual action plan and a short note for finance to approve.

Attachments: Flycap_Mutual_Action_Plan.pdf, credit_approval_note.txt

—
Lauren Bishop
